content:
Emma: quick sync - we need to finalize rerank score encoding + routing sensitivity before the quota/dashboard rollout tomorrow. console buckets spiked in yesterday's canary, noticed by infra alerts. anyone have immediate theories?
Raj: saw the alert. runtime returns float32 but the telemetry collector packs to int16 to save bytes. the packing shifts dashboard bucket boundaries.
Miguel: packing was intentional for throughput; didn't expect it to break SLA buckets.
Sara: product: console and SLA-alerts assume continuous score ranges. quantization causes noisy alerts. can we normalize in the console short-term?
Kevin: quota calc uses `score_units = ceil(score * weight)`. quantization makes throttle decisions oscillate. bigger risk for customers.
Emma: options: (A) keep int-packed + publish stable bucket mapping, (B) emit float32 end-to-end, (C) emit histograms instead of per-candidate scores. pros/cons?
Raj: (A) low infra work but brittle; (B) clean semantics, ~12% bandwidth increase; (C) good for dashboards but loses per-candidate debugging info.
Miguel: we can mitigate (B) with gzip and selective trace sampling.
Sara: rollout UX: per-tenant opt-in + console toggle to compare legacy vs normalized buckets and a per-model distribution preview.
Emma: prefer model-scoped toggles. different models have different score distributions so routing sensitivity must be model-scoped.
Raj: that means router needs `model_id` and optionally a distribution signature -> adds routing metadata and cache-key cardinality.
Kevin: OK if it stabilizes SLAs. ops wants a global fallback mapping when signature missing.
Miguel: implementation: collector emits both `score_float` and `score_q16` during transition (`score_q16 = int16(round(score_float * 32767))`). telemetry pipeline carries both; console shows toggle. after 2w flip default to float.
Emma: proposed proto for canary:
```
message RerankScoreEvent {
  string model_id = 1;
  float score_float = 2; // new canonical
  int32 score_q16 = 3;  // legacy packed (optional)
  map<string,string> meta = 4;
}
```
Raj: router will prefer `score_float` when present, decode `score_q16` otherwise. I'll add tests.
Sara: product will add "Use legacy score encoding" toggle with tooltip and a timestamp for when float started. also distribution preview in rollout modal.
Kevin: gating: canary on 5% tenants, SLO: <=2% change in 95th throttle rate and <=1% uptick in on-call alerts. I'll build a side-by-side dashboard comparing buckets.
Emma: @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `rerank-collector/v2` on cluster `rerank-canary-1` (pods:3). mem<70%, p50 latency +2ms.
Emma: action items: Miguel -> collector dual-field canary; Raj -> router fallback + tests; Kevin -> SLO checks & dashboards; Sara -> console toggle + copy; Emma -> rollout plan + platform announcement. reconvene after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
